name: Sleeping Shaq
meaning: Shaq sleeps peacefully in the top panel and is wide awake with glowing eyes in the bottom. For not caring about one thing but getting very excited about another.
when_to_use: top = the thing you do not care about (left of the sleeping panel). bottom = the thing that wakes you up (left of the glowing panel). The bottom is the punchline.
baked_in_text: The image already labels the panels "i sleep" (top) and "real shit" (bottom). Captions only name the two things.
